sources.label: My Morphe patches for the apps I use, in one source for Morphe Manager.
sources.author: Noam
patch_list: The iOS-based app's animation themes: one colour transform over the game's effects (Neon, Gold, Ice, Rainbow and more), with previews and a live preview on the Themes page.
No ad is ever requested or shown; flows that would wait on an ad continue at once. Toggleable in the Mod settings.
Takes away the app's permission to use the internet, so nothing in it (game, ads, analytics) can go online.
The block looks of the iOS-based app (ASCII, Nothing, pixel, neon, glass and more), picked in the Mod settings.
The iOS-based app's colour themes for the game screen (OLED, Midnight, Candy and more), picked with previews on the Mod settings Themes page.
Writes the screens the game opens to files/bbmod.log in the app's data (for troubleshooting the patches).
Replace impossible Classic trays with a playable three-piece sequence. Works with Android and iOS generation; toggleable in Mod settings.
A Classic game ends at game over without the revive offer, as in the iOS-based app.
Adds a screen-shake toggle to the Mod settings, off to start with.
How far a held piece moves for each finger movement, on every screen size.
The iOS-based app's seven extra effects: magnet drag, particles, landing bounce, big-clear flash, score pulse, thumbs-up and touch haptics. All off by default, toggled in Mod settings.
Show a chosen number as the Classic best score; the real record keeps tracking underneath and comes back when the option is turned off. Set in Mod settings.
The result screen opens as soon as the board has filled, without the extra wait.
Every new Classic game starts on an empty board in the original skin, and the tutorial is skipped.
Hides the "you defeat X% of players" fail animation and the chapter top-rank badge. Toggleable in Mod settings.
Classic trays are dealt by the real iOS 7.4.3 game code, which runs inside the app and plays along with every move; Android's own algorithm is skipped. Toggleable in the Mod settings.
The score multiplier uses a fixed number of login days instead of counting the days you open the game.
The iOS-based app's menu themes for the home screen; Original follows the colour theme. Picked with previews on the Mod settings Themes page.
Removes the Hungry Studio wordmark from the boot splash (the activity window background shown while the engine loads), leaving its plain gradient until the loading screen appears.

More games becomes the game's own Back-to-home button (and More games is gone everywhere), and the default-skin row hides itself while the patches' own themes are in use. Toggleable in the Mod settings.
